community_list_entries.name: MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A benchmark explicitly for the 'memory capability' of video world models: entity, environment and causal consistency over long horizons in generated video. It is a memory benchmark, but the subject is video generation models rather than LLM agents, and none of the 8 types apply.
